simple.meaning: שֹׁר (shôr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a string (as twisted ), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

occurrences.englishText: It will be health to your body,
As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.
